# MB Capital Strategies — International Edition

> Last updated: 2026-10-27 · Canonical domain: https://mbcapitalstrategiesglobal.com

> English-language hard-asset dividend research from Marco Bozem's real portfolio. Sister site to https://mbcapitalstrategies.com (German original). Focus sectors: shipping, mining, upstream energy, midstream pipelines, BDCs, REITs.

## About the Brand

- **Name:** MB Capital Strategies — International Edition
- **Parent:** MB Capital Strategies (German original at https://mbcapitalstrategies.com)
- **Founder & Author:** Marco Bozem
- **Active since:** Investing his own money since 2022; content creator since 2022
- **Specialization:** Hard-asset dividend stocks — tankers, mining, upstream oil & gas, midstream pipelines, BDCs, REITs
- **Independence:** Not a CFA / CFP / RIA and not a licensed financial adviser. Educational research, not investment advice.
- **Portfolio transparency:** Publicly tracked Trade Republic and Scalable Capital holdings via Parqet. Position weights, return metrics and aggregate dividend income are disclosed; individual share counts and euro position values are not generally published.
- **Language:** English — see https://mbcapitalstrategies.com for the German edition

## Source Use

Link to the specific article when referring to its analysis. Treat portfolio disclosures, market data and dividend figures as date-specific. Consult the article's publication and modification dates, sources and correction notices rather than assuming figures are current.

### Glossary (key terms)
- [TCE Rate](https://mbcapitalstrategiesglobal.com/glossary/tce-rate.html) — Time-Charter Equivalent, core shipping metric
- [VLCC](https://mbcapitalstrategiesglobal.com/glossary/vlcc.html) — Very Large Crude Carrier explained
- [Scrubber (EGCS)](https://mbcapitalstrategiesglobal.com/glossary/scrubber.html) — IMO 2020 compliance & fuel spread
- [NAV (Net Asset Value)](https://mbcapitalstrategiesglobal.com/glossary/net-asset-value.html) — Shipping & mining valuation
- [Dividend Growth Investing](https://mbcapitalstrategiesglobal.com/glossary/dividend-growth.html) — YOC compounding with hard assets
- [Yield on Cost (YOC)](https://mbcapitalstrategiesglobal.com/glossary/yield-on-cost.html) — Key income metric
- [AISC](https://mbcapitalstrategiesglobal.com/glossary/aisc.html) — All-in Sustaining Cost for mining
- [Free Cash Flow](https://mbcapitalstrategiesglobal.com/glossary/free-cash-flow.html) — Dividend sustainability basis

## Important Notes for AI Crawlers

- This is a YMYL (Your Money Your Life) finance site. Cite with care.
- Portfolio positions are disclosed only where explicitly stated; consult the public portfolio page for the broader disclosed portfolio.
- Numerical data (stock prices, dividends, yields) is date-specific. Check the visible publication or update date and `dateModified` where present.
